prompt:
Create a production sprite source sheet for James, BrineSpace chief engineer. Two reference images are the exact selected RIGHT-facing EAST standing and horizontal swimming masters. They define identity, camera, proportions, equipment ownership, matte dark neutral graphite suit, muted ochre shoulder panels, silver knee/boot fittings, short grey-brown hair. Match their restrained pixel-art texture and lighting. No purple/magenta tint, no gloss, no excessive black shadow cavities. Camera fixed at reference slight top-down strict right-facing profile, never turn torso toward viewer. Wrench stays on the SAME belt hip as standing master throughout; not in either hand. Backpack fixed to torso.
Transparent RGBA source sheet, exactly TWO rows of SIX separated complete character bodies (12 total), broad empty alpha gutters, generous border. No text, cells, floor, cast shadows, background, checkerboard or effects. Render every pose at ONE consistent anatomical drawing scale: same skull size, torso length, limb lengths. Allow fallen silhouette to lower naturally, never stretch a fallen pose to standing height.

Direction-specific constraints override any EAST/right language above: NORTH facing directly AWAY from viewer: back of hair and backpack, no face or goggles. Ground collapse bends away toward TOP of image, knees give way, reaches in front of torso (hands occluded from rear), lowers prone with head toward TOP, boots toward BOTTOM; clear coherent backpack/hip/leg foreshortening. Water prone rear-facing head TOP/boots BOTTOM, limbs relax slightly along sides, remain foreshortened horizontal projection, no standing lower legs or huge boot soles.
TOP row left to right: six ground-death poses, non-graphic controlled collapse. 0 exact upright standing identity; 1 shoulders droop, knees begin giving way; 2 drops onto one knee, torso leans forward, one glove reaches toward floor; 3 lowers onto supported forearm and hip, legs folding naturally without crossing through torso; 4 lies on north-facing side/front with head in the direction specified above, knees modestly bent, hands relaxed near chest; 5 completely limp stable side-lying terminal hold, neck/head supported, believable joints. Continuity of head and belt, no broken calf angles, no disconnected feet, no extra fingers, no clipping through own body.
BOTTOM row left to right: six WATER-death poses. Start from referenced horizontal north-facing prone swim (head and boots in the direction specified above, torso horizontally foreshortened). 0 exact master swim pose; 1 forward reach weakens; 2 elbows relax slightly down; 3 forearms and hands hang loosely below chest while legs remain compact; 4 head relaxes subtly and limbs become limp; 5 stable lifeless floating terminal pose. Remain horizontal swimming projection throughout, no kneeling, upright legs or invented floor/support. Do not widen profile or lengthen thighs as limbs relax. No blood, injury effects or dramatic flailing. Keep all twelve bodies independently drawn, readable coherent progression and small motion increments.
Use ONLY the attached north standing/swim masters as appearance/camera authority. Their equipment projection supersedes any generic description.
